title: Split a string by a separator
description:
Write a function `split_text(text, separator)` that splits `text` on `separator` and returns the resulting list.

Covers source items 13-14 (splitting on a space, and splitting on a comma) as one exercise.
examples:
split_text('Coding For All', ' ')
-> ['Coding', 'For', 'All']
split_text('Facebook, Google, Microsoft', ',')
-> ['Facebook', ' Google', ' Microsoft']
hints: text.split(separator) breaks text into a list everywhere separator occurs, dropping the separator itself from the results.
Call .split(separator) on text and return the result - no loop needed.
expected_behavior: Returns text split on separator, as a list of strings.

hidden_tests.call: split_text('Facebook, Google, Microsoft, Apple, IBM, Oracle, Amazon', ',')
hidden_tests.expected: ['Facebook', ' Google', ' Microsoft', ' Apple', ' IBM', ' Oracle', ' Amazon']
hidden_tests.label: source item 14, split on comma

explanation: str.split(separator) is the general form - passing a space or a comma is just a different argument to the same method, not a different technique.
